value.answer: Depends on your down payment. If it's under 20% (insured), the lowest 5-year fixed I found is 4.34%, from Frank Mortgage per WOWA's Oct 9 list, and Ratehub has it today too. If you're putting 20% or more down (uninsured), the lowest is 4.44%. The big banks are higher, averaging around 5.14%. Rates have been creeping up this month, so they're moving.
